binders: A dimension m, integer-indexed cell averages, an arbitrary state value at the origin, an arbitrary two-state flux function, and an interface index i.
conclusions: The constructed local interface data have cell i-1 as their left state and cell i as their right state.
mathematical_definitions: The local data equal U_{i-1} for x<0, U_i for x>0, and valueAtOrigin for x=0.
translation.proposition_plain_english: At any integer interface i, the canonical piecewise data built from adjacent cell averages satisfy the left/right data predicate, and the interface flux definition evaluates to the supplied two-state flux on those adjacent values.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The origin value is arbitrary and the left/right predicate does not constrain it.
The riemannFlux function is arbitrary; no consistency, conservation, entropy, exact-solver, stability, or accuracy property is assumed.
The dimension m may be zero.
